messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — PartnerCo asked for a starter pack that wires our hosted model endpoint into their VPC + a Terraform module to automate onboarding. Can we scope deliverables?
Maria Gomez: +1. Proposed scope: 1) Reference arch diagram (AWS + GCP variants), 2) Terraform module to provision connector + IAM + LB, 3) sample app (node/python) showing auth + calls, 4) marketplace packaging + publishing notes.
Jordan Patel: I can own the TF module. Questions: do we need to support both Private (VPC) and Hosted (API key) modes in the same module, or separate modules? Also need to support arm64 AMIs for on-prem/Dedicated demos.
Devon Li: I'll take the diagrams and readme. For Private deployments we should include KMS/HSM considerations and an optional PrivateLink/Private Service Connect section.
Taylor Nguyen (Partner): From PartnerCo side: PrivateLink is a hard requirement for our customers. We also need an example minimal IAM policy and a step for verifying egress rules.
Maria Gomez: Let's do a single module with a mode variable: mode = ["hosted","private"], default "hosted". That keeps consumer surface smaller.
Jordan Patel: Sounds good. Draft module API sketch: ```hcl
variable "mode" { type = string default = "hosted" }
variable "partner_vpc_id" { type = string default = "" }
variable "region" { type = string }
output "connector_endpoint" { value = aws_lb.app.dns_name }
resource "aws_lb" "app" { /* light example */ }
```
Jordan Patel: I'll include a CI smoke test that runs the sample app against a local mock of our inference API using a recorded response. Keeps costs down in CI.
Alex Chen: Timeline? Can we have an internal review in 8 business days and partner preview in 2 weeks?
Maria Gomez: I can scaffold the repo and open a template PR today. Will add checklist: docs, diagrams, TF examples, quickstart script, CI smoke test, changelog entry, LICENSE.
marketplace-bot: Created repo redwood/partner-starterpack-connector and added ISSUE_TEMPLATE checklist.
Taylor Nguyen (Partner): Great — are there constraints on AMI/kernel or do you supply container images for Dedicated? Our infra team prefers containerized stacks.
Jordan Patel: We will publish a reference container image (ECR) and a VM AMI for offline demos. Module will accept image_id or container_image variable.
Devon Li: For diagrams I'll create a single-page PDF + mermaid source in repo so partners can fork.
Alex Chen: Risks: region-specific AMIs, private connectivity flakiness, doc clarity around keys. Call out region matrix in README.
Maria Gomez: Action items: Jordan = TF module + CI, Devon = diagrams + quickstart, Alex = partner coordination & release notes, Taylor = provide minimal IAM policy and PrivateLink endpoint test details. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue.
Taylor Nguyen (Partner): I'll send the IAM snippet and PrivateLink acceptance tests later today. :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: Putting a draft module PR up by EOD tomorrow. Will add arm64 test matrix.
Alex Chen: Awesome — thanks team. :rocket:
